# Primitives

The raw values of Brand expressive. Primitives hold the values; semantic tokens give them a job (see [Foundations](../foundations/index.md)), and components read only the jobs.

**119** primitives. **81** are used by a semantic token, a theme or a component key. **38** are not used yet: they stay, so a brand or a changed answer can use them without adding a value.

| Kind | Primitives | Used |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Color](./color.md) | 74 | 42 |
| [Space and size](./space-and-size.md) | 12 | 10 |
| [Shape](./shape.md) | 6 | 5 |
| [Type](./type.md) | 18 | 17 |
| [Motion](./motion.md) | 4 | 2 |
| [Effects](./effects.md) | 5 | 5 |
